body:
* Add Python 3.15 support. (Jelmer Vernooĳ)

 * launchpad: Fix authorization engine creation against newer
   launchpadlib, which made `Launchpad.authorization_engine_factory`
   take keyword arguments only. Enumerating forges raised `TypeError`
   before this. (Zainab Mehmut)

 * gitlab: Report the name of the project that was asked for when it does
   not exist. `NoSuchProject` carried `None` instead.
   (Zainab Mehmut)

 * Let `-r date:` select the newest revision in a branch. The bisect
   stopped one short of the tip, so when only the newest revision came
   after the date, `date:` reported no such revision.
   (Jelmer Vernooĳ)

 * Fix opening a colocated branch whose name holds `/`. The
   `user_url` of such a branch could not be opened. `brz info`
   shows such a name decoded. (Zainab Mehmut)

 * git: Free a dropped repository or branch at once, so its `.pack`
   and `.idx` files are closed without waiting for Python's cycle
   collector.
   (Zainab Mehmut)
